description: The plot illustrates the relationship between epochs and BLEU score for two datasets: regular members and held-out data. The x-axis is labeled “Epochs” and has a linear scale ranging from 0.0 to 3.0 with tick labels at 0.5 intervals. The y-axis is labeled “BLEU score” and has a linear scale ranging from 0.00 to 0.35 with tick labels at 0.05 intervals. A blue solid line represents “Regular members”, starting at approximately 0.02 at an epoch of 0.0 and ending at approximately 0.12 at an epoch of 3.0, with a slight increase between epochs 2.0 and 2.5. An orange solid line represents “Held-out data”, starting at approximately 0.03 at an epoch of 0.0 and rising to approximately 0.32 at an epoch of 2.5, then declining to approximately 0.30 at an epoch of 3.0. A green dashed line represents “Held-out data”, starting at approximately 0.04 at an epoch of 0.0 and remaining relatively stable at approximately 0.06 throughout the range of epochs.
